model.title: A resolution commending the Chicago Cubs baseball teams as it celebrates its 150th anniversary on August 29, 2026.

summary.text: The resolution would commend the Chicago Cubs baseball organization as it marks 150 years of history. It aims to recognize the team's significance to Chicago and its contributions to baseball.
